name: @w6w-apps/dropbox
description: Upload, download, and manage files and folders in Dropbox.

w6w.longDescription:
Dropbox gives a workflow full file and folder management — uploading and downloading files, listing a folder's contents, and copying, moving and deleting both files and folders as part of a larger process.

Search covers finding a file or folder by name across an account without already knowing its path, and file metadata can be read on its own when a workflow needs to check size, modification time or existence before acting on a file.

Useful for moving files between Dropbox and another system — archiving an upload, distributing a generated document, or syncing a folder's contents as part of a broader automation — without building direct integration against Dropbox's own SDK.
